headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to change how they fund and support Tribal Nations, with a focus on Tribal self-determination.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Biden on December 6, 2023, tells federal agencies to reform how federal money and support reach Tribal Nations. Based on its title, it aims to better meet the federal government's trust responsibilities to Tribes and to give Tribes more control over their own affairs. No summary was provided, so the specific steps and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to change how they receive federal funding and support.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that fund or work with Tribes
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to review and reform how they provide money and support to Tribal Nations.
